metadata.build: cargo build --release --bin rove; fat LTO, one codegen unit; default target features; NEON runtime backend
metadata.method: Sequential groups of four concurrent chains, alternating workload order across repetitions; no separate warmup. External wall time includes startup, trace/tree IO, checkpoints and final comparison. Burn-in 10% by sample count. No BEAST timing comparison.

model.substitution: Mk per partition, equal frequencies, four shared midpoint gamma categories normalized to mean one
model.gamma_shape_prior: Exponential(mean=1), parameter bounds [0.001, 1000], density without truncation normalization
model.branch_rate_prior: independent LogNormal(mu=-sigma^2/2, sigma), positive rates; BEAST clock initialization sets lower bound to zero
model.rate_mapping: node index; last node uses the root index when it is not the root; root has no branch rate
model.clock: branch length in time units times trace.clock_rate times relative branch rate; see dating settings
model.tree_prior: FBD, fixed origin and process parameters, removal probability zero, restricted to terminal fossils and supplied age bounds; unnormalized restricted density, not model evidence
